entities.summary: Heinrich Ludolph (Ludwig) Wendland was a botanist who described and named several Acacia species. Along with his father Johann Christoph Wendland (1755–1828) and his son Hermann Wendland (1825–1903), he was the second of three generations of Wendlands who served as court gardeners at the Königliche Herrenhäuser Gärten founded in 1638 by the Hanoverian court.
